spotlights.summary: High Masters to Champion 5 in 3 weeks.
spotlights.notes:
![Beleo's Winstreak after a few HONE sessions.](/assets/uploads/screenshot-2026-07-15-143052.png "Winstreak")

Beleo worked closely with coaches EOO/Trip and psev to hit Champ 5 in only 3 weeks. 2-3 vods a week and with effort put in from Beleo, he was able to quickly climb to Champ 5. We worked not only on his gamesense, but also his aim, more specifically micro corrections and general control tracking to improve smoothness and corrections.

Beleo also transitioned from a Soldier one trick to a full fledged hitscan in the given timeframe. Working closely with EOO/Trip, he improved not only on Soldier, but on Cassidy, Widowmaker, and Sojourn.

Give him a follow, [here on twitter](https://x.com/beleofps).

![Beleo hitting Champ 5 on July 27th, 3 weeks after the beginning of the program.](/assets/uploads/screenshot-2026-07-28-083504.png "Beleo Hitting Champ")
